regions.today: Staying mostly cloudy this evening, with a few bright or sunny spells possible in places. There will be some well scattered showers too. All in light to moderate, sometimes gusty, northerly winds.
regions.tonight: Overnight, it will be dry for most, with plenty of clear spells and little cloud. An isolated shower will push down from the north. Lowest temperatures of 6 to 10 degrees in light to moderate northwesterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: On Friday, there will be a bright and sunny start to the day for most. However, cloud and some scattered showers will sweep down from the north during the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees in light to moderate northerly winds.
